review.text: I can't believe I didn't leave a review when Sean and his crew roofed my house 2 years ago. He and his team are professional friendly amd very skilled. He has done work for friends of mine and they are all very satisfied. If you want an honest roofing contractor that responds quickly you have found it.
review.notes: Typo 'amd' kept as written; only on the full-review card.

posts.instagram:
Two years later, Paul still made a point of leaving a review. That means a lot.

Thank you, Paul. We're glad your friends have been happy too.
